description: This file contains unit tests for the Abseil C++ library's PCG engine implementations, including golden value checks, seed and discard tests, serialization, and interface compliance.

classes.name: PCGEngineTest
classes.description: Template test fixture for PCG engine types, using Google Test framework.

methods.name: VerifyReseedChangesAllValues
methods.description: Tests that reseeding the engine changes its output values and that the bits change as expected.

methods.name: VerifyDiscard
methods.description: Tests the discard functionality of the engine to ensure it produces consistent sequences after discarding.

methods.name: StreamOperatorsResult
methods.description: Checks that stream insertion and extraction operators work correctly with the engine.

methods.name: StreamSerialization
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of the engine state via stream operators.

methods.name: RandomNumberEngineInterface
methods.description: Verifies that the engine conforms to the C++ Random Number Engine requirements.

methods.name: RandenEngineSFINAETest
methods.description: Tests SFINAE constraints and construction options for the engine.

methods.name: VerifyGolden
methods.description: Checks that the engine produces expected golden output sequences for different engine types.

methods.name: VerifyGoldenSeeded
methods.description: Checks that seeded engines produce the expected sequences.

methods.name: VerifyGoldenFromDeserializedEngine
methods.description: Verifies that deserialized engine states produce the same output sequences as original.
